description: Paychex, Inc., a Delaware corporation incorporated in 1979 that maintains dual corporate headquarters in Rochester, New York and Cincinnati, Ohio and has a fiscal year that ends on May 31st, is an industry-leading human capital management company providing comprehensive technology and advisory solutions in human resources, payroll processing, employee benefits and insurance. As of May 31, 2026 it served approximately 840,000 total customers across the U.S. and parts of Europe, of which approximately 800,000 are payroll clients, and it continues to invest significantly in its proprietary technology, HCM platforms, advisory solutions and benefits to maximize value for its customers and their employees, believing it is well positioned to capitalize on AI opportunities through its large and growing data sets, predictive analytics and AI models, and continued investments to increase efficiency, enhance the customer experience, support better outcomes and create growth opportunities.
